android.desc:
Compatibility: this application works on 3rd generation of Dacia Sandero, Dacia Sandero Stepway and Dacia Logan models fitted with the Media Control system. 

With Dacia Media Control, you can easily use your smartphone while driving 

 

Dacia Media Control is a highly practical, smart application designed to perfectly integrate with your Dacia vehicle. Its user-friendly interface helps you to discover a new way of using your smartphone/tablet with your Dacia, and to access all the functions of your phone and vehicle in an ergonomic and intuitive way! 

 

All your communication in your vehicle: 

 

- Customisable interface: customize your interface with the shortcut pages and widgets available to you. You have access to the full universe of your smartphone within your Dacia Media Control application. Mix information you want to display on your welcome page - GPS, music, rev counter, radio etc. Turn your phone or tablet into a second dashboard and take to the road serenely! 

 

Navigation: select your navigator and navigate accurately using the app of your choice*** to guide you to your destination. The new shortcut pages allow you easier access to your favourite navigation applications on your phone.  

 

Phone: place and receive calls easily while driving. Just received a text message? No problem, the SMS-to-Speech* function reads the message out loud and you keep your eyes on the road, for full safety! 

 

- Vehicle: your vehicle on your smartphone/tablet: Dacia Media Control is integrated ** into your vehicle via Bluetooth. Follow the information on the on-board computer from your smartphone/tablet and use the Driving Eco functions to drive economically. 

 

- Media: listen to the music you like amongst thousands of web radio stations, music on your phone, a USB flash drive or the vehicle radio. 

 

 

Dacia Media Control must only be used in respect of highway regulations and conditions. 

NOTES:  

- Continued use of the GPS function can considerably reduce the battery life of your mobile device.  

- Access to social networks, search engines and internet radio requires a mobile internet connection. 

- For more details about our personal data protection policy, please visit Dacia website. 

* SMS and SMS-to-Speech are only available on Android 

** Dacia Media Control/vehicle connection is only available on Dacia vehicles equipped with Media Control system 

*** list limited on iOS

quotes.text:
Then you want the Dacia Media Control.

It has a phone holder where other trim levels would place the screen, and USB power around there.

Other than that, the car is mostly Bluetooth a speaker.

They actually have an app that allows you to tune the FM radio, otherwise I don't think you can listen to radio broadcasts.

https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dacia.dngo
